fact {
    root in G
    root.l in Imply
    root.l.r in F

    x6 in root.*(l+r) // pc0_a4
    x2 in root.*(l+r) // pc0_CS

    all n: root.*(l+r) | (n.l.*(l+r) & n.r.*(l+r) & Literal) = none // literals appear once in a formula
}
